tvShow.name: Creature Commandos
tvShow.overview: Follow the exploits of the Creature Commandos, a secret team of incarcerated monsters recruited for missions deemed too dangerous for humans. When all else fails... they're your last, worst option.

episodes.name: The Collywobbles
episodes.overview: Amanda Waller assembles the Creature Commandos -- led by General Rick Flag Sr. -- and sends them to Pokolistan to protect Princess Ilana Rostovic.

episodes.name: The Tourmaline Necklace
episodes.overview: As Ilana continues her pursuit of Flag, The Bride shows Nina where she was created -- and relives Frankenstein's rocky attempts to woo her.

episodes.name: Cheers to the Tin Man
episodes.overview: As the Creature Commandos attempt to save The Bride and Nina, GI Robot relives his glory days -- and finally gets his wish.

guest_stars.character: Exuberan Host / Prosecuting Attorney / Son of Chemyscira 1 (voice)
guest_stars.name: Piotr Michael

episodes.name: Chasing Squirrels
episodes.overview: The Creature Commandos return home to understand Circe's motivation, while Weasel reflects on the events that landed him in Belle Reve.

episodes.name: The Iron Pot
episodes.overview: Frankenstein is nursed to health by a new friend. Later, Flag and Frankenstein team up to disprove Circe's visions about the Princess.

episodes.name: Priyatel Skelet
episodes.overview: As Dr. Phosphorus is born of his own research, the Creature Commandos find themselves on the eve of destruction.

guest_stars.character: Butler / Head Amethyst Knight / Mustachioed Knight (voice)
guest_stars.name: Julian Kostov

episodes.name: A Very Funny Monster
episodes.overview: Nina's birth proves unexpectedly complicated, while the Princess attempts to escape death at the hands of the Creature Commandos once and for all.

guest_stars.character: Ivan the Cabbie / Royal Pokolistan Security Guard (voice)
guest_stars.name: Nickolai Stoilov

reviews.author: SteveForsing
reviews.content: This show has everything you want for both comic and non comic book fans.  It's well written, witty and includes a lot of great cameos.  Please bring us a season two!  I really recommend it.

reviews.author: DallasBob
reviews.content:
I'm late to the party, but this was actually a pretty good series. It definitely didn't take any of the sorry woke dips in writing you'd - >groans< - normally expect from most any comic orientated entity of the past 7-10 years. Loved the adult themes, violence, team-ups, and plot twists in both narrative and scheme. I can't say I like giving Gunn *any* flowers, given the luke warm output in making his Superpeople movies, but this series was masterfully written. It downright makes you wonder if he bypassed someone who is put in a specific position, to ruin scripts/narratives with DEI/ESG statuettes, in order to get the series aired; it's that good.

I can't believe I'm actually using this phrase for a comic studio source in motion media, but "I really hope" - god, that feels weird - there is a second season just to see if this first season wasn't a one-off, i.e., blind luck. (*Peacemaker* ring any bells?)

Hope you enjoy viewing as much as I did! -- Bob --
